items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet; high risk for go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases. Fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, checks, findings, or site results. Operations has no deploy, uptime, or error-sweep results. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. Compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. Recommend preserving private-launch and security-sensitive release gates while allowing ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. This is risk triage, not penetration testing or certification; no vulnerability or clean bill of health is claimed.

Retain the existing consolidated security evidence matrix; do not create duplicate security proposals or request duplicate telemetry. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only.
